senses.gloss: m., only in pl. מַרְצוּפִים, (רָצַף) מַרְצוּפִין packing bags, leather bags, esp. adapted for ship-loads.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:1">B. Bath. V, 1</cite>. Y. Sabb. X, end, 12ᵈ, v. <cite ref="H00205"><he>חָדַק</he></cite>; a. fr.—[Cmp. μάρσιπος, marsupium, prob. of Semitic origin.]
